sentences.en: The whole is greater than the sum of the parts.
sentences.zh: 整体而言，部分之和小于整体。

sentences.en: The whole sky lit up and there was an explosion.
sentences.zh: 整个天空都亮了起来，并发生了爆炸。

sentences.en: On the whole, I am in favor of your opinion.
sentences.zh: 总体来说，我赞成你的观点。

senses.zh: 整个的，全部的；完整的，未经分割的；健全的，完好的
